author: marici.Strominger

scope.strength: symbolic all-grade theorem for both known exception templates

checks.statement: the general q=1 exceptional template has the displayed 2x2 block
its determinant vanishes among g>=2 exactly at g=2
at grade two the primitive q=1 circuit is (1,-1)
the q=g+5 collision template has a fixed 3x3 minor
the 3x3 minor vanishes among g>=2 exactly at g=2
at grade two the primitive collision vector is (1,-3,2)
the grade-two alignment is precisely q=7
the restoring third row is proportional to g-2

verdict: Both known magnetic exception geometries are grade-two-only boundary shortenings. The q=1 reflected a=0 pair has minor -g(g-2)rf(4,g)^2. The q=g+5 block on a=0-,4+,6+ has minor -4g(g-2)(g+5)rf(6,g-1)rf(4,g)^2. Both are nonzero for every g>=3 and degenerate at g=2 to the primitive circuits (1,-1) and (1,-3,2), with q=g+5=7 in the latter case.
